title: The Eyeflash Miracles
author: Gene Wolfe
note: conf=0.93; ISFDB title record #41421 lists it as a standalone SHORTFICTION (novella) by Gene Wolfe, first published 1976; no series affiliation shown. It first appeared in the anthology Future Power (1976, ed. Dann & Dozois) and was reprinted in the collections The Island of Doctor Death and Other Stories and Other Stories (1980) and The Best of Gene Wolfe (2009) — those are collections/anthologies, not a series. Nebula-nominated novella. The ebook is a standalone digitization of the novella.
